tagline: Your Ocean City vacation, one question away.

food.name: Fish Tales Bar & Grill
food.genie_tip: A strong choice for families who want waterfront dining while the kids have something fun to do.

food.name: Layton's Family Restaurant
food.genie_tip: A good casual breakfast stop before heading to the beach.

food.name: The Shark on the Harbor
food.reservation_note: Reservations suggested; call for same-day availability
food.genie_tip: Consider this for travelers looking for a more food-focused seafood dinner overlooking the harbor.

food.name: Spain Wine Bar
food.address: 13 St. Louis Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
food.reservation_note: Reservations available and recommended for popular times
food.genie_tip: A strong date-night option when someone wants rooftop views, cocktails and shareable food.

food.name: The Hobbit Restaurant
food.genie_tip: A good match for couples wanting a more elevated dinner and sunset experience.

nightlife.name: Seacrets
nightlife.genie_tip: Recommend when adults want one of Ocean City's biggest nightlife experiences with dancing, DJs and live entertainment.
nightlife.current_info_note: Entertainment schedules, cover charges and seasonal operations can change. Check the current calendar before recommending a specific event.

nightlife.name: Fager's Island
nightlife.genie_tip: A strong option for visitors who want to start with sunset drinks or dinner and transition into live music and nightlife.
nightlife.current_info_note: Entertainment and special-event schedules change, so verify the current calendar.

nightlife.name: Purple Moose Saloon
nightlife.address: Between Talbot and Caroline Streets on the Boardwalk, Ocean City, MD
nightlife.genie_tip: Recommend when someone specifically wants live rock music or nightlife directly on the Boardwalk.
nightlife.current_info_note: Band schedules and operating hours vary by date and season. Check the current calendar.

teens.name: SpeedWorld
teens.genie_tip: A strong recommendation when teens want something active and competitive instead of just walking the Boardwalk.
teens.current_info_note: Hours and attractions are seasonal. Check current operating information before visiting.

teens.name: Jolly Roger at the Pier
teens.address: 401 S Atlantic Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
teens.genie_tip: Recommend for teens who want rides, games and the energy of the Boardwalk, especially as part of an evening downtown.
teens.current_info_note: Ride availability and operating hours vary by season and weather.

teens.name: Ocean City Boardwalk Arcades
teens.genie_tip: A flexible teen option that can easily be combined with Boardwalk food, shopping and rides.

teens.name: Mini Golf
teens.genie_tip: A good lower-key choice for teens who want something social and competitive without spending an entire day at an amusement park.

teens.name: Ocean City Watersports
teens.genie_tip: Recommend for active teens looking for something more adventurous. Match the activity to age requirements, comfort level and weather conditions.
teens.current_info_note: Availability, age requirements, weather restrictions and seasonal schedules vary by operator.

date_night.name: Spain Wine Bar
date_night.address: 13 St. Louis Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
date_night.reservation_note: Reservations available and recommended for popular times
date_night.genie_tip: A strong choice for couples wanting a polished rooftop date with sunset views, cocktails and shareable food.

date_night.name: The Hobbit Restaurant
date_night.genie_tip: Recommend when a couple wants a quieter, elevated dinner centered around food and a beautiful sunset.

date_night.name: Seacrets Cruises
date_night.reservation_note: Check the current cruise schedule and reserve ahead
date_night.genie_tip: A fun alternative to a traditional dinner date when a couple wants to get out on the bay and watch the sunset.

rainy_day.name: Ocean City Life-Saving Station Museum
rainy_day.address: 813 S Atlantic Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
rainy_day.genie_tip: A good rainy-day choice for visitors who want an inexpensive indoor activity while learning about Ocean City's coastal history.
rainy_day.current_info_note: Hours vary seasonally, so check the current museum schedule before visiting.

rainy_day.name: Sportland Arcade
rainy_day.address: 506 S Atlantic Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
rainy_day.genie_tip: Recommend when families or teens want an easy indoor activity without leaving the Boardwalk area.

rainy_day.name: Fun City Arcade
rainy_day.genie_tip: Another useful Boardwalk option when rain interrupts outdoor plans.

rainy_day.name: Museum of Ocean City
rainy_day.address: 217 S Baltimore Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
rainy_day.genie_tip: Pair this with the Life-Saving Station Museum for visitors interested in local history and a longer indoor itinerary.
rainy_day.current_info_note: Hours vary seasonally, so verify current hours before visiting.

rainy_day.name: Rainy Day Shopping
rainy_day.area: Ocean City and West Ocean City
rainy_day.genie_tip: Recommend shopping when visitors want a flexible rainy-day plan that can be combined with lunch, coffee or dessert.

things_to_do.name: Ocean City Boardwalk
things_to_do.genie_tip: A must for first-time visitors. Recommend walking, biking during permitted hours, grabbing Boardwalk food or combining it with rides and arcades.

things_to_do.name: Ocean City Beach
things_to_do.genie_tip: Recommend when guests want a simple free activity, beach day or early-morning sunrise experience.

things_to_do.name: Jolly Roger Amusement Parks
things_to_do.genie_tip: A strong choice for families and teens. Always remind guests to check which parks and attractions are currently open because schedules are seasonal and weather-dependent.

things_to_do.name: Northside Park
things_to_do.genie_tip: Recommend for visitors wanting a quieter free activity away from the Boardwalk crowds.

things_to_do.name: Inlet Park
things_to_do.genie_tip: A simple free stop for guests who want water views, photos or a relaxing break near the south end of the Boardwalk.

seafood.name: On the Bay Seafood
seafood.genie_tip: A fun choice when someone wants a casual Maryland crab experience rather than an upscale seafood dinner.

seafood.name: Higgins Crab House
seafood.genie_tip: Consider Higgins when visitors specifically want the traditional sit-down Maryland crab-house experience.

seafood.name: OCM Crabs
seafood.genie_tip: A useful option when someone specifically asks for an all-you-can-eat crab experience.

seafood.name: Crab Alley
seafood.address: 9703 Golf Course Rd, Ocean City, MD 21842
seafood.genie_tip: A good match for visitors wanting steamed crabs with a West Ocean City harbor setting.

seafood.name: Hooper's Crab House
seafood.genie_tip: A classic Ocean City-area choice for visitors wanting the full crab-feast experience in a lively waterfront setting.

seafood.name: Harrison's Harbor Watch
seafood.address: 806 S Atlantic Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
seafood.genie_tip: Consider this when someone wants seafood with one of Ocean City's signature inlet views.

seafood.name: The Shark on the Harbor
seafood.genie_tip: A strong option when the guest cares more about a chef-driven seafood meal than a traditional crab feast.

seafood.name: Waterman's Seafood
seafood.genie_tip: A practical choice for families or groups wanting a broad traditional seafood menu.

free_and_budget.name: Ocean City Beach
free_and_budget.genie_tip: One of the easiest completely free Ocean City experiences. Suggest sunrise or an evening beach walk for visitors who want something memorable without spending money.

free_and_budget.name: Ocean City Boardwalk
free_and_budget.genie_tip: Walking the Boardwalk costs nothing. Recommend setting a small snack or treat budget if guests want the Boardwalk experience without spending heavily.

free_and_budget.name: Northside Park
free_and_budget.genie_tip: A good free alternative when visitors want a quieter experience away from the busiest parts of Ocean City.

free_and_budget.name: Inlet Park
free_and_budget.genie_tip: Recommend for a simple scenic stop, especially when guests are already visiting the south end of the Boardwalk.

free_and_budget.name: Ocean City Sunrise
free_and_budget.genie_tip: Recommend as a completely free romantic or peaceful experience. Pair it with an inexpensive coffee or breakfast afterward.

free_and_budget.name: Sunset on the Bayside
free_and_budget.genie_tip: A great foundation for a low-cost date night. Suggest watching the sunset and adding dessert, ice cream or another inexpensive treat.
